title: uretOS CloudEvent v1.0 Specification
description: Standardized CloudEvent envelope for all asynchronous message exchanges across uretOS services. This is documentation/reference only - services copy this file locally rather than importing it as a shared package (hyper-decoupled principle).

id.description: Unique identifier for the specific event instance.

source.description: Identifies the context or service in which an event happened (e.g., 'uretos/services/machine-command-service').

type.description: Describes the type of event related to the originating occurrence (e.g., 'uretos.machine.command.create').

time.description: Timestamp when the occurrence happened (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339).

correlationid.description: Mandatory tracing ID passed across execution flows to correlate events, commands, and queries.

messagetype.description: Explicit message categorization for strict workflow handling.

tenantid.description: Identifies which tenant this message belongs to. Reserved value 'system' is used for super_admin-level operations such as tenant provisioning itself.

subject.description: Optional subject of the event in the context of the event producer (e.g., entity ID).

data.description: Domain payload associated with the message.
